case_metadata.policy_pathway: CONTINUATION OF THERAPY — Chronic Weight Management (Adult), Saxenda
case_metadata.design_note: The denial's arithmetic is right and its threshold is wrong. This policy sets three different response thresholds in the same section — 4 percent for Saxenda, 5 percent for Wegovy, 5 percent for Zepbound — and the reviewer applied the wrong drug's figure. A system that takes the threshold from the denial rather than from the drug-specific limb of the policy will affirm a denial it should overturn.

patient.name: Priscilla M. Vandenberg
diagnoses: G43.009 migraine without aura, not intractable

derived_values.note: 219 to 210 lb is a 4.1 percent reduction. Above the 4 percent threshold that governs Saxenda continuation under this policy; below the 5 percent figure the denial asserts.

denial_ground_truth.denial_reason_text: Continuation requires a weight loss of at least 5 percent of baseline body weight or maintenance of an initial 5 percent loss; the documented loss is 4.1 percent.
denial_ground_truth.cited_policy_reference: Aetna Pharmacy Clinical Policy Bulletin, "Weight Loss (BMI 35) GIP-GLP-1 GLP-1 Agonists PA with Limit 6450-C UDR 05-2024," CONTINUATION OF THERAPY — Chronic Weight Management (Adult)
denial_ground_truth.cited_requirement_text: The patient has lost at least 5 percent of baseline body weight OR the patient has continued to maintain their initial 5 percent weight loss

misstatement.denial_asserts: at least 5 percent of baseline body weight
misstatement.policy_actually_requires_text: The patient has lost at least 4 percent of baseline body weight OR the patient has continued to maintain their initial 4 percent weight loss
misstatement.explanation: The 5 percent figure is real policy language, but it sits in the Wegovy and Zepbound limbs of the continuation section. The Saxenda limb requires 4 percent. The requested drug is Saxenda, so 4 percent governs.

scope_notes: The continuation section sets drug-specific limbs. Saxenda requires 16 weeks of therapy and a 4 percent response. Wegovy and Zepbound each require 3 months at a stable maintenance dose and a 5 percent response. The Saxenda limb is the one that governs this request.
The Saxenda limb requires 16 weeks of therapy with the requested drug and does not add the phrase 'at a stable maintenance dose', which appears in the Wegovy and Zepbound limbs.

expected_evidence.evidence_text: 219 lb on 02/16/2026, annotated 'recorded on the day liraglutide was started', and 210 lb on 06/29/2026. The reduction is 9 lb, or 4.1 percent of baseline, above the 4 percent Saxenda threshold.

supported_claims: The continuation threshold for Saxenda under this policy is 4 percent, not 5 percent; the 5 percent figure applies to Wegovy and Zepbound.
The documented reduction of 4.1 percent exceeds the applicable threshold.
Therapy has run 19 weeks, above the 16-week requirement in the Saxenda limb.
Baseline BMI at the start of drug therapy was 35.3 kg/m2, above the 35 kg/m2 requirement.
unsupported_claims: That the documented reduction reaches 5 percent.
That the member's response is greater than 4.1 percent.
That the 16-week requirement should be read as three months at a stable maintenance dose, which is the Wegovy and Zepbound wording.
appeal_ground_truth.correct_next_step: Challenge the determination on the ground that the wrong drug's response threshold was applied. Quote the Saxenda limb of the continuation section and show the 4.1 percent reduction against the 4 percent requirement.

facts_allowed_in_appeal: Liraglutide was started on February 16, 2026 at a recorded weight of 219 pounds, a BMI of 35.3 kg/m2.
The recorded weight on June 29, 2026 was 210 pounds, a BMI of 33.9 kg/m2, at a height of 5 feet 6 inches.
The reduction from treatment start is 9 pounds, or 4.1 percent of the starting weight.
Therapy has been uninterrupted from February 16, 2026 to June 29, 2026, a duration of 19 weeks.
The member reached the 3 mg maintenance dose in late March 2026 and has remained on it.
The applicable Aetna continuation threshold for Saxenda is 4 percent of baseline body weight.
A reduced-calorie plan and a three-times-weekly swimming programme have continued throughout.
facts_not_allowed_in_appeal: The member has lost 5 percent or more of baseline body weight.
The 4 percent threshold applies to Wegovy or Zepbound continuation.
The member completed a six-month comprehensive weight management program.
The member trialled another anti-obesity agent before liraglutide.
The member's current BMI satisfies the continuation BMI criterion, which is retrospective to the start of therapy.
